lanes.blurb: Find the holes while they are cheap

lanes.label: Ship
lanes.blurb: Docs and release match the code

nodes.summary: Writes the plan from a scan of the real codebase.
nodes.detail: Creates and updates development plans: objective, phases, files to modify, test strategy. A fresh-context exploration worker gathers verified paths, patterns, and dependency versions first, so the plan cites the codebase instead of guessing at it.
Interviews you one question at a time. The skill verifies facts against the codebase. It asks you only about genuine judgement calls, each with a recommended answer you can accept, change, or waive.

nodes.summary: Five fresh-context lenses audit the plan.
nodes.detail: Architecture, sequencing, spec-and-testing, assumptions, and codebase-claims lenses audit the plan against the actual code, then a contradiction pass flags conflicts inside the plan. A signed-off plan carries a review marker that `conduct` checks.

nodes.summary: Runs the plan phase by phase.
nodes.detail: Walks a reviewed plan one phase at a time. Each phase's implementation, test, and fix loop runs in a clean-context subagent, so the main session stays a conductor and does not run out of context. The skill writes state to `.conduct/`, so `--resume` picks up an interrupted run.
Takes 2+ independent tasks from a plan, runs each agent in its own git worktree, then merges and verifies the results.

nodes.summary: Chains the review gates into a loop.
nodes.detail: Runs the review gates, applies fixes through isolated fixer subagents, and goes round again until findings stop appearing. Auto-chained from `conduct` and `fan-out` when the plan sets `Review Gates: full`. Its ledger lives in `.gauntlet/`, so `--resume` continues an interrupted run.

Five independent reviewers cover logic, security, spec compliance, architecture, and documentation. Each starts with clean context. The review step reconciles findings across lenses, so duplicates collapse.
Claude Code's built-in security review of the pending changes. Not part of skein; the gauntlet runs it as one of its gates.
Claude Code's built-in `/code-review`. The harness blocks a model from invoking it, so no skill can chain it. Run it yourself before the gauntlet.

nodes.summary: Fixes docs the diff made stale.
nodes.detail: Checks dev plans, the changelog, `README.md`, `AGENTS.md`, and the PR description against the branch diff, then offers targeted updates. Not chained by the gauntlet; run it once reviews have converged.

nodes.summary: Cuts a release from the changelog.
nodes.detail: Creates or re-syncs a GitHub release from a `CHANGELOG.md` section, and audits tags, releases, and changelog versions for drift.

tools.summary: Finds IETF RFCs by topic or number and returns links, not paraphrase.
Maps RFC 2119 MUST, SHOULD, and MAY requirements to code: Met, Missing, Partial.
Picks a diagram, tree, or diff over prose when it explains faster.
Turns a folder of dev plans into an HTML dashboard of status and cross-references.
Drafts a TIL or blog post from the current session.
Reviews Markdown against a style guide and returns graded findings with fixes.
